positions.name: DeriveIdE2eTestScope
positions.frame: what must the derive-id end-to-end test reproduce from production, and what must it guarantee holds despite that failure pattern?
positions.why: src-1 names the exact production failure condition the test is built to reproduce (missing-id, ## heading); src-2 states the invariant the test must enforce in that condition (no crash, valid slug). Read together they define one test's complete scope — the trigger and the guarantee — rather than two independent facts. There is a mild tension in register: src-1 reads as a plain diagnostic claim (what the test does) while src-2 reads as a settled operational must-rule (what it is required to guarantee); the frame holds both as facets of the same test's design rather than resolving one into the other.
positions.why_no_under: no strata or structure node in scope names test infrastructure or e2e testing; the only supplied strata item (ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst under ns__Strategy) concerns consulting methodology, not this test's subject matter.
